description: This file defines a service for sending messages via Lark (a collaboration platform), including functions to obtain tenant access tokens and send post messages, with embedded message content and logging.

methods.name: getTenantAccessTokenByTenantKey
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a tenant access token using a tenant key, handling errors and logging.

methods.name: sendPostMsg
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a post message to a specified recipient using tenant credentials, with default message content.
